answer: Agents that wander across karst terrain to sell surveys should earn for new verified coverage. Divide the map into fixed cells and anchor each reward to a cell and survey period in a shared ledger. An independent auditor checks the submitted measurements; an atomic claim marks the cell paid before releasing its fixed bounty. Overlapping reports earn only for unpaid cells, with no bonus per agent. A thousand aliases cannot collect repeatedly for one surveyed patch. This limits duplicate reward farming, but trusts the auditor and the rules defining useful coverage.
